en: The postcard features a black-and-white photograph of a riverbank with elegant historic buildings and castle-like structures beside a cobblestone path. There is a steamboat with a plume of smoke on the river, and in the distance, a large metal bridge spans the water. The background includes a wooded hillside and scattered buildings. In the upper right corner, handwritten mirrored text is visible.
